title: MIT Technology Review The Download — Week 23 Digest
summary: Weekly newsletter roundup from MIT TR aggregating multiple tech stories.
body: Candidate was MIT Technology Review's The Download newsletter covering 6 distinct tech stories: an AI safety regulation proposal, a new chip architecture, a quantum computing milestone, an open-source framework release, a cybersecurity disclosure, and a startup acquisition. All stories should be surfaced individually through their primary sources rather than as a newsletter wrapper. The roundup adds no original analysis and fragments newsworthy stories that deserve focused coverage. Rejected per editorial policy: newsletter roundups are unpacked to primary URLs, not surfaced as candidates.
rejection_reason: newsletter-roundup-wrapper | MIT TR The Download week 23; 6 stories should surface via primary sources

pipeline_steps.output_summary: Intake kill — newsletter wrapper rejected; candidates to be re-filed from primary URLs
